build_self_training_classifier: build a self-training classifier that learns from labeled and unlabeled data using a base SVM estimator
fit_semi_supervised_model: fit a SelfTrainingClassifier with partially labeled data where unlabeled samples use -1 as their label
test_predict_labels: test the SelfTrainingClassifier predict method to generate class labels for new data
refactor_threshold_criterion: refactor the SelfTrainingClassifier fit method to use threshold criterion for selecting high-confidence pseudo-labels
review_metadata_routing: review the SelfTrainingClassifier get_metadata_routing method and its method mapping for estimator parameter routing
